scientific_integrity: The voter-model weighted-fixation formula is credited as established prior work. The new assertion is an exact hub no-flip event factorization and size-biased asymptotic. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary binary neighbor-copy voter dynamics with an initially unique hub opinion; the asymptotic expansion requires uniformly bounded private clique sizes. Numerical checks cover finite graph orders and do not prove infinite cases. Priority beyond accessible literature is uncertain.
title: Exact hub persistence on clique bouquets and its size-biased blade law
